history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man stands with his back to the camera, facing a large black banner with white text and a graphic design. He is wearing a black t-shirt with white text on the back that reads "Solo Raya Gangster" in a gothic font with a red scribble over the word "Raya." Below this, smaller white text is visible but unreadable. He is also wearing distressed denim jeans.

The banner behind him features the bold white text "BARAT GANGSTER" across the top. Below this, a dramatic graphic depicts a large full moon in a cloudy, night sky with silhouetted trees and flying bats. To the right of the moon, a large, feathered wing extends downwards, and a shadowy figure of a wolf or beast is visible at the bottom. The overall style is dark, edgy, and somewhat gothic or punk-rock inspired.

The lighting appears to be artificial, casting a slight shadow on the man and the banner. The color palette is dominated by black and white, with a small accent of red on the t-shirt. The mood is mysterious and somewhat intimidating. The banner is hung from a metal structure, suggesting it might be displayed in a workshop, garage, or event space.
